purpose: Predeclared analysis plan for thesis Subchapter 5.7.3 sequence calibration

fps_selection.pipeline_population: quality_pass frames only, because t_pipeline includes preprocessing + model inference + output read on the inference path
fps_selection.metric: p95_pipeline_ms per device pooled across all 40 sequences
fps_selection.rule: select the highest candidate FPS that does not exceed f_max on either target device

smoothing: mean of complete eight-class score vectors

replay_sampling.description: For FPS below the 5 FPS collection stream, retain the first logged observation then the first subsequent logged observation whose elapsed time is at least ceil(1000/FPS) ms from the previously retained observation. This mirrors RecognitionSession's interval gate as closely as possible using the recorded stream.

target_episode.definition: Merge contiguous analysis_role=target stages when expected_label is the same. Nominal sequences therefore form one target episode spanning baseline/action/recover; transition sequences form object_a and object_b episodes.
target_episode.decision_time_start: first quality-pass replayed observation inside the target episode
target_episode.wrong: at least one announced nominal in the episode differs from expected_label
target_episode.correct: at least one expected nominal is announced and no wrong nominal is announced
target_episode.reject: no nominal announcement is produced before the target episode ends

sequence_success.stable_motion_distance_orientation: the merged nominal target episode outcome is correct
sequence_success.nonmoney: no nominal announcement occurs during analysis_role=nonmoney
sequence_success.transition: both nominal target episodes are correct; for a labelled nonmoney/empty middle stage, no nominal may be announced there; an unlabeled direct-transition middle stage is diagnostic only

mssr.name: balanced_macro_scenario_success_rate
mssr.calculation: mean sequence success rate across the six scenario groups; POCO and Redmi are equally represented in every group

quality_gate.rule: retain candidate if MSSR >= best_MSSR - SE(best_MSSR) and correct-acceptance rate is > 0 for every nominal class
quality_gate.tie_at_best: if multiple candidates share the maximum MSSR, use the largest bootstrap SE among the tied best candidates so the one-SE gate is conservative
quality_gate.interpretation: selection rule, not a statistical equivalence test

final_lexicographic_selection: minimize P95 decision time among correct target episodes
minimize median decision time among correct target episodes
prefer shorter temporal window if all previous criteria tie
prefer higher confidence threshold if all previous criteria tie
nonmoney_handling: Nonmoney correct rejection contributes to sequence success; nonmoney false nominal announcements are reported separately and influence MSSR through nonmoney sequence success.
frame_level_youden: Computed as descriptive/initial confidence evidence on nominal target observations; final configuration is still chosen from the full threshold x temporal-window replay.
important: This plan is intended to be frozen before candidate-result inspection. Do not alter selection priorities after seeing the result table.
